subject: Re: Apexia LLM pilot — deprioritized for Q4 feature launch
messages:
From: Liam Cole <liam@apexia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Product Team <product@apexia.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot for Q4

Marissa —

Thanks for the outreach and for the great demo prep you ran with our data last week. After the all-hands this morning the exec team has decided to pull most engineering effort toward a critical product launch in late Q4. That means we need to deprioritize exploratory projects, including the LLM/inference pilot we discussed.

We still see the value, but the timing won't work for us until we get through this launch. I attached the Q4 roadmap (internal) so you can see where energy is going.

Can we park the demo for now and I’ll ask you to reach back in mid-Q1? If you have a short proposal for a minimal pilot window that would be easier to slot later, feel free to send it.

Apologies for the churn — happy to revisit when things calm down.

— Liam
Liam Cole
Head of Product
Apexia

Attachment: Apexia_Q4_Roadmap_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam Cole <liam@apexia.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Apexia LLM pilot — deprioritized for Q4

Hi Liam —

Totally understand and thanks for the heads up. Congratulations on the upcoming product launch — sounds like a big push.

We can absolutely pause the live demo/workshop. A couple of quick things I recommend so this stays tidy on both sides: 
- We’ll log this as a hold in the CRM (APX-3387) and set a reminder to reach back in early March.
- I attached a lean pilot proposal (1-week eval, sample telemetry + cost estimates) that maps to a low-touch window if you want something to drop into the roadmap later.
- If the launch date slips or a specific team wants to run a fast spike, feel free to loop us back in — we can often do a 2-hour technical check that doesn’t require engineering time on your side.

Proposed next steps: I’ll mark the deal as "paused" and we’ll schedule a Q1 check-in for the week of 2027-03-07. If that timing looks wrong I can update.

Thanks again; I’ll keep this on a soft cadence so it doesn’t fall off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-demo-proposal-APX-3387.pdf (PDF, 480KB)
